title: DVB-T2 preset and graph-API example for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Express the full DVB-T2 BICM chain (BCH + LDPC + bit
interleaver + Gray-QAM + AWGN + soft demap + inverse) via the
typestate-builder preset; provide a graph-API example that
constructs the same chain piece-by-piece.

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application on
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Both forms (typestate preset + graph-API construction)
  produce byte-identical output for a fixed input batch on the
  full DVB-T2 BICM forward + inverse chain at all six in-scope
  MODCODs.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
